source.book: An Intimate Note to the Sincere Seeker — Gurudev Sri Sri Ravi Shankar

slides.text: Why does loyalty feel so rare these days?
Disloyalty isn't malice. It's just *opportunism* wearing a nicer name.
A divided mind can't stay loyal to anything, including itself.
Loyalty starts with a yes-mind — quiet, whole, unafraid to *commit*.
Say yes to something, all the way
